$comment: Groups the public types of qar-streaming-sharp on the C# API landing page and in its sidebar, in this order. A type is placed by its exact name in `types` first, then by the longest matching name prefix in `prefixes`. Names are DocFX display names (`Result<T>`). scripts/run-docfx.js warns about every type no area claims and lists it under `Other`, so a new type never disappears.

areas.label: Library and runtime
areas.description: Load the native library and create the runtime that onboards and rejoins sessions.

areas.label: Onboarding and sessions
areas.description: Join a QAROS session for the first time, rejoin it later, invite devices and start target apps.

areas.label: Peers and hands
areas.description: The peers in a session, their presentation and the hand-tracking data devices send.

areas.label: App volumes
areas.description: The 3D volumes an application renders into, their gestures and world anchoring.

areas.label: GUI panels
areas.description: Flat 2D panels placed in the room and the gestures users make on them.

areas.label: Rendering
areas.description: Render senders stream frames for a target peer: frame begin/show, views, stream parameters per graphics API.

areas.label: Video senders and frames
areas.description: Video streams without a primary render target, and the frame and texture types every sender hands out.

areas.label: Results and errors
areas.description: Every call returns a `Result<T>` instead of throwing; these types carry the outcome.

areas.label: Math and time
areas.description: Value types shared by every area.
